name: Management
source:
You were a young coach for a small university before but your fate will soon change completely as you’ve just received a letter of recommendation from one of the best sports universities in Tokyo!

There you’ll meet a group of promising young athletes and talented teachers.
And after sweating a bit with them and going through exciting training and experiences…
Perhaps will you find love and much more…

[From [url=https://redroomcollective.carrd.co/#currentprojects/]Red Room Collective[/url]]
translation:
你以前是一所小大学的年轻教练，但你的命运很快就会完全改变，因为你刚刚收到了东京最好的体育大学之一的推荐信！

在那里你会遇到一群有前途的年轻运动员和才华横溢的老师。
在与他们一起流汗并经历了令人兴奋的训练和经历之后……
也许你会找到爱等等……

[来自[url=https://redroomcollective.carrd.co/#currentprojects/]Red Room Collective[/url]]
